subject: Commercial evaluation & finance handoff — Acme Health
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@acmehealth.com>
To: avery_johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation & commercial plan for Acme Health — next steps

Avery,

Thanks for the run-through today — our leadership liked the latency/throughput numbers for the dedicated pool. As discussed, we'd like a short mutual action plan that ties evaluation milestones to commercial milestones so procurement can approve the PO and finance can align billing. Key asks from our side:

- A 6-week evaluation with a production-acceptance milestone (perf tests + security checklist)
- Clear invoicing cadence (monthly in arrears preferred by Finance)
- PO requirements (Acme standard PO with vendor W-9 and SOC 2 attestation)
- Payment terms: we can push for Net60 but need to understand Redwood's sensitivity — any discount for Net60 / 12-month commit?

Attaching a rough MAP template for your team to fill in. Can we aim to finalize commercial terms and PO language by the week of Jun 15 so procurement can raise the PO?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire O'Neill
Director, Platform Integrations
Acme Health Systems

Attachment: MAP-Acme-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: avery_johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acmehealth.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & commercial plan for Acme Health — next steps

Claire — great to connect. Drafting the MAP and commercial terms below; I pulled in Dev to confirm ramp assumptions and Grace will handle the finance handoff. High level:

MAP / evaluation plan (6 weeks)
- Week 0: Kickoff; access + test data provisioning
- Week 2: Integration + 1st perf run (latency/throughput)
- Week 4: KV/prefix cache validation and security checklist
- Week 6: Production acceptance (sign-off triggers billing start)

Commercial milestone alignment
- Pricing: quoted as $0.015/token for evaluation tier (capped at 150M tokens). Dedicated pricing thereafter at $0.011/token under an initial 12-month commit.
- Ramp & discounts: 10% discount on committed spend for a 12-month agreement — available if PO references the committed SKU.
- Billing start: by default billing begins on production acceptance date (Week 6), but if you want billing to start on first production requests we can accommodate with an earlier invoice date.
- Payment terms: Standard is Net30. For enterprise customers with a formal PO/commit we can accept Net60 (no additional fee) for deals > $200k ARR; smaller pilots will remain Net30.

PO + invoicing cadence
- We prefer a single PO with line items for evaluation credits and committed capacity. Finance prefers monthly invoicing in arrears; we can provide monthly invoices with Net60 terms if procurement requires.
- Required docs: Redwood W-9 (attached), SOC 2 Type II report (we'll provide secure link), and vendor contact for invoicing.

I've attached our PO template (Acme_PO_Template.pdf) and a first-pass MAP (MAP-Acme-v2.xlsx). Please flag if procurement needs specific wording. If this looks good we'll move to legal redlines and have procurement issue a PO next week.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_PO_Template.pdf, MAP-Acme-v2.xlsx

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: avery_johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & commercial plan for Acme Health — finance/legal notes

Avery / Dev — quick legal/finance notes before we send to Acme procurement: 

- Accept Net60 for this deal given ACME's size; remove surcharge — recommend we require a signed 12-month commitment to trigger the 10% discount so we protect unit economics.
- Invoice cadence: Finance prefers monthly in arrears with line-item detail (evaluation vs committed). That maps well to their internal AR process.
- Billing start: Agree billing should start on production acceptance milestone. If Acme explicitly requests billing on first production request, we should add a clause: "Billing start may shift earlier upon written request from customer and will be reflected in the first invoice."
- PO: ask procurement to include a PO number and remit-to info; we cannot accept verbal PO commitment for the discount.

I'll create a short redline for Commercial_Terms_v1.docx and circulate. If you need me to join the procurement call next Wed, I can.

-Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acmehealth.com>
To: avery_johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation & commercial plan for Acme Health — next steps

Avery / Claire — thanks for the clarity. Procurement is comfortable moving forward on the following:

- We will raise a PO referencing the 12-month committed SKU for the discount. PO will be Net60.
- Billing start: we prefer billing to begin on production acceptance (as defined in MAP Week 6). If Redwood requires an earlier billing start, please flag and we'll discuss.
- Required attachments: Acme needs Redwood's SOC 2 link and completed W-9 on file before PO publication.

We will circulate the PO draft by Jun 18. Please send the SOC 2 link and the redlined commercial terms so legal can turn around quickly.

Regards,
Rajesh Kumar
Director, Procurement
Acme Health Systems

From: avery_johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@acmehealth.com>, Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Evaluation & commercial plan for Acme Health — final MAP & next steps

Rajesh / Claire — thanks, this aligns with our expectations. Quick summary and next steps:

- MAP & billing: Billing will begin on production acceptance (Week 6). We'll accept Net60 on the PO; the 10% committed discount is conditional on the signed 12-month order form referencing the agreed SKU.
- Deliverables sent: MAP-Acme-v2.xlsx, Acme_PO_Template.pdf, Commercial_Terms_v1.docx (redline attached).
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II link: https://secure.redwoodinference.com/soc2/acme-access (access request sent)
- Action items:
  1) Acme: publish PO (Net60) and confirm expected PO number by Jun 22.
  2) Redwood: provide signed order form and DocuSign link for the 12-month commitment by Jun 19.

DocuSign (order form): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-2026-117

If those dates work, I'll get our legal team to sign and Grace will schedule the finance onboarding for invoicing.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
